example.title: Samo Capri: white apartment block over carports
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A c. 1970 two-storey white stucco apartment block raised over carports, a tall blank stair tower with the house number, script lettering 'Samo Capri' on the front wall, plain windows and a dracaena palm. One photo. Scaled to the lot. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
